scope: D30 v5 audit sheet, 40 items, two writers, two independent readers

rater1.rule: not named; section 18 shows derived multiples were accepted as grounded

rater2.rule: strict grounded: a number absent from the panel is not grounded, derived or not

attestation.statement: the strict-grounded D30 sheet was scored by an independent second rater

consequence: D30 preference direction is read twice independently; the grounded column is the only place the two readings conflict, and it conflicts because the rule differed
